rounds.question: Name a reason the United States entered World War I

answers.text: German submarine attacks on US ships
answers.explanation: This is a reason the US entered WWI — German U-boats attacked American merchant ships, killing US citizens.
This is a reason the US entered WWI — Germany's secret offer to Mexico to attack the US in exchange for territory was intercepted.
This is a reason the US entered WWI — Germany sank the British liner in 1915, killing 1,198 people including 128 Americans.

answers.text: To make the world safe for democracy
answers.explanation: This is a reason the US entered WWI — Wilson's idealistic framing cast the war as a crusade for democratic values.
This is a reason the US entered WWI — cultural, economic, and financial bonds with Britain and France pulled the US toward the Allies.

rounds.question: Name something in Wilson's Fourteen Points

answers.text: Creation of the League of Nations
answers.explanation: This is from Wilson's Fourteen Points — Wilson's dream of a peacekeeping organization was the centerpiece of his postwar vision.
This is from Wilson's Fourteen Points — he believed people had the right to form their own governments, reshaping Europe's map.
This is an Early Republic principle — the US insisted on its right to trade freely without interference from warring European powers.
This is from Wilson's Fourteen Points — Wilson believed secret diplomacy had caused the war and demanded open negotiations.
This is from Wilson's Fourteen Points — he called for military disarmament to reduce the threat of future wars.

rounds.question: Name a reason the Senate rejected the Treaty of Versailles

answers.text: Fear of being drawn into foreign wars
answers.explanation: This is a reason the Senate rejected the Treaty of Versailles — isolationists feared the League's collective security clause would pull the US into every conflict.

answers.text: Opposition to the League of Nations
answers.explanation: This is a reason the Senate rejected the Treaty of Versailles — Henry Cabot Lodge led Republicans who opposed surrendering Congress's war power to the League.
This is a reason the Senate rejected the Treaty of Versailles — Americans were tired of European entanglements after the war's massive casualties.

answers.text: Congress wanted control over war powers
answers.explanation: This is a reason the Senate rejected the Treaty of Versailles — the League's Article X seemed to give the League authority to commit US troops.

answers.text: Treaty was seen as too harsh on Germany
answers.explanation: This is a reason the Senate rejected the Treaty of Versailles — some Americans thought the punitive terms would destabilize Europe.

rounds.question: Name a social or cultural change of the 1920s

answers.explanation: This is a 1920s cultural change — Black artists, writers, and musicians in New York created a flourishing of African American culture.

answers.text: Prohibition and the rise of speakeasies
answers.explanation: This is a 1920s social change — the 18th Amendment banned alcohol sales, generating organized crime and underground bars.
This is a 1920s change — installment buying and advertising created the first mass market for cars, appliances, and radios.
This is a 1920s cultural change — young women challenged Victorian norms with short hair, jazz, and public independence.

answers.text: Growth of the Ku Klux Klan
answers.explanation: This is a 1920s social change — the revived Klan expanded from the South to target Catholics, Jews, and immigrants nationwide.

rounds.question: Name a cause of fear and intolerance during the Red Scare

answers.explanation: This is a cause of the Red Scare — the 1917 Russian Revolution alarmed Americans and fueled hysteria about radicals at home.
This is a cause of the Red Scare — many 'subversives' targeted by the Palmer Raids were immigrants with left-wing political views.
This is a Red Scare event — Attorney General Palmer ordered mass arrests of suspected radicals, deporting many without due process.
This is a Red Scare consequence — the raids violated First and Fourth Amendment rights and set a troubling precedent for wartime repression.
This is a Red Scare event — two Italian anarchists were convicted of murder in a trial widely seen as driven by anti-immigrant prejudice.

rounds.question: Name something that contributed to the Great Migration

answers.text: Escape from Jim Crow laws in the South
answers.explanation: This is a cause of the Great Migration — racial terror and legal segregation pushed Black Southerners to seek dignity elsewhere.
This is a cause of the Great Migration — WWI cut off European immigration, creating factory jobs in cities like Chicago and Detroit.

answers.text: WWI created labor shortages in the North
answers.explanation: This is a cause of the Great Migration — with young men overseas and immigration halted, Northern employers actively recruited Black workers.

answers.text: Racial violence and lynching in the South
answers.explanation: This is a cause of the Great Migration — nearly 4,000 Black Americans were lynched between 1877 and 1950, driving millions north.

answers.text: Growth of Black communities in cities
answers.explanation: This is a consequence of the Great Migration — Harlem, Bronzeville, and other urban communities became centers of Black culture and politics.
